Why I started Meridian

Great businesses were losing work to busier profiles

I kept seeing the same thing. A plumber or cleaner with years of happy customers would sit on page two of Google, below a competitor who simply had more reviews and a profile that was clearly looked after.

The fix isn't complicated. Ask every customer for a review, keep your Google profile active and send people to a website that makes it easy to book. Most owners just don't have the time to do it every week, so that's what we do for them.

Marcus Burst · Founder, Meridian AI Solutions
